Builds software from zero-to-one — production ML pipelines, compiler infrastructure, and the distributed systems in between. His work bridges bare-metal inference and responsive UI, with a focus on voice-first clinical AI and privacy-by-design infrastructure.

## Long bio
Prashanth T., known online as StarOne01, is an ML Systems Engineer based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Currently a third-year Electrical & Electronics Engineering student, he is a self-taught programmer driven by curiosity about how complex systems work. He specializes in building software from zero-to-one through deep exploration and investigative problem-solving. His work spans production machine learning pipelines (custom ASR, Whisper fine-tuning, speaker diarization, on-prem LLM inference), compiler infrastructure (active LLVM contributor), and distributed systems (Go backends, privacy-by-design architecture, end-to-end encryption).

## Roles (current)
- Founder, Software Development Agency — Coimbatore-based, funding other ventures. Delivers high-end web projects, custom AI agent systems (e.g., WhatsApp bots), and enterprise software for real estate, studios, and manufacturing clients.
- Founder, self (primesoma) — In development. AI-native dating platform matching people through meaningful conversation. Full-stack: Go/Gin backend, Flutter mobile app, end-to-end encryption.

## Roles (upcoming)
- Founder, primesoma — Vertically integrated wellness ecosystem: food, groceries, farms, fitness, health. Plans to own the entire stack end-to-end.

## Roles (past)
- Co-founder, Medclara — Voice-first, multilingual clinical documentation platform. Doctor-patient conversations are converted into structured SOAP notes using custom ASR and LLMs. Prashanth co-founded this company. The role is now concluded.

## Open source & research
- LLVM — Active contributor. 15+ merged PRs including float-related changes across the codebase.
- EfficientXLang — Original research project assessing cross-lingual reasoning in multilingual LLMs. A study on whether reasoning compresses across languages and where it does not.
- PhraseNuX — Open-source C++ CLI password manager with AES encryption. Zero dependencies, audited crypto. Repository: https://github.com/StarOne01/PhraseNuX
- Authored a technical content series on production AI realities.

## Areas of expertise
1. Production ASR & ML — Custom ASR architectures (Conformer, RNN-T, CTC), Whisper fine-tuning with QLoRA, speaker diarization, on-premise LLM inference via Ollama with structured outputs.
2. Systems & Infrastructure — Privacy-by-design backends for AI companions: GDPR (Art. 9, 22), India DPDP Act, CCPA / CPRA, US state AI companion laws. Argon2id encryption, Go services, AWS, GCP.
3. Compilers & Open Source — LLVM contributor, PhraseNuX, cross-lingual reasoning research.
4. Creative Technologies — Unreal Engine 5 cinematics, DaVinci Resolve pipelines (cinematic editing, color grading, export).
